name: void-language
description: VOID compiler language assistance, navigation, guarded rename, formatting and diagnostics.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting works; native server execution requires workspace trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: voidls requires a local filesystem project on the extension host.

void.editor.useTabs.description: Indent VOID code with tabs. Disable to insert four spaces. Changing this setting does not convert existing text.

void.server.path.description: Native voidls executable, absolute or workspace-relative. Empty checks a bundled native server, then PATH. No shell expansion or downloads.

void.project.entry.description: Literal entry source, absolute or workspace-relative. With project.root: an in-root manifest entry override. Alone: legacy entry-parent mode. Empty uses compiler-owned project preflight with legacy main.void/standalone fallback only when no manifest is selected.

void.trace.server.description: Optional LSP trace in the VOID output channel. Verbose logs can include source text.

void.project.root.description: Literal manifest root, absolute or workspace-relative. Pins project mode even for malformed TOML or no main. With project.entry, that entry must stay inside this root. Empty uses compiler-owned nearest-manifest discovery unless a legacy entry is configured.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out dist/void-language-0.1.0.vsix
